finalText:
**17 call sites** still pass the legacy rounding flag, out of 221 total `formatAmount` calls across the 10 caller files.

**`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.**

Full breakdown:

| File | 2-arg calls | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 | 16, 37, 58, 83, 104 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 | 16, 45, 74 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 | 16, 37, 62 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 | 16, 57 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 | 16, 53 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 | 16 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 | 16 |
| `src/reports/ledger.js` | 0 | — |
| `src/billing/refunds.js` | 0 | — |
| `src/admin/dashboard.js` | 0 | — |

Notes for the migration:

- Every one passes the literal `true` — no variables, no `false`, no computed flags — and each is preceded by the same `// TODO: drop the legacy rounding flag once every caller is migrated` comment. So the mechanical edit is uniform: strip `, true` and the TODO line.
- All calls are single-line, so a regex sweep on `formatAmount\(([^,)]+), true\)` catches all 17 with no multi-line cases to miss.
- Not purely cosmetic: `format.js:6` gives half-away-from-zero for the flagged calls vs. half-to-even otherwise, so those 17 sites will change output on exact-half cents (e.g. `0.125` → `0.13` today, `0.12` after). Worth checking whether any of them are load-bearing for reconciliation before you drop the flag.
- Repo is 11 `.js` files total, all under `src/`; no tests, no other languages, so this sweep is complete.
